reviews.title: A great customizable PC case.
reviews.comment:
The components in this kit were of pretty good quality, I wish the plastic components were made of metal as well but for the price I'm definitely satisfied with the quality of this kit.
If you're purchasing something like this chances are you already have tools for PC assembly but this kit also came with a set of pliers and a nice little screwdriver set, so if you happen to have zero tools at your disposal this kit will give you something to start with.
If you're building PCs for a hobby you can definitely handle the DIY aspect of this kit. If you're in the market for an open air case for your build this is a great budget option. The kit also comes with black plastic pieces if you aren't a fan of the red accents.
reviews.author: Sean J.

reviews.title: Awesome test bench
reviews.comment: Love this test bench case. My server is in a closet where I don't have to worry about it getting hit. The openness make it easy to clean. Could use better drive and gpu mounts but with the extruded aluminum you can make whatever you want.
reviews.author: nwneisen

reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment:
Pros:
1. Material quality is good.
2. Assembly instructions/pictures very good.
3. Comes w/small hand tools.
4. Comes with custom "ruler" for assembly, great idea.
Cons:
1. Need to go online for assembly instructions/pictures.
2. A lot assembly required.
3. Small hand tools, low quality.
4. GPU bracket not so great, but work.
Anyone building PCs has hand tools, remove small hand kit and lower price.
Amazon picture shows "horizontal" GPU mounting, kit does not come with PCI adapter.
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.title: LOVED this frame
reviews.comment:
I can't call it a case really, but this was great.
I recently rebuilt my media center PC with a newer motherboard, CPU, RAM, Nvidia 5060, and a water cooler for the CPU.  And thanks to the wonderful Amazon search feature, and my lack of paying close attention, I ended up purchasing a full sized ATX case despite the search for mini atx...  Needless to say it wouldn't fit my old case.
Since I had everything apart, I wanted something that could arrive overnight.  This was one of the few things that could, and so I tried it.
LOVED the simplicity.  Setup was ridiculously easy.  I still have three 20 TB spinning drives to supplement my Synology in the basement for media, and local is where I keep all the 4k stuff.  I was concerned that the noise level may be higher without the case helping keep some of those small internal noises muffled, but it's dead silent sitting on the floor behind my entertainment center and TV.
The ease of placing things was such a unique experience.  Put it where you want it, not in the bays that it has to go in.
The handle up top was the cherry on top for me.  When I'd need to pull this out for something it was a bit of a pain getting it picked up in the limited space I have behind the TV.  The handle now makes that a gamechanger.
Absolutely worth every penny.
reviews.author: LegoDude

reviews.title: Surprisingly Easy to Assemble and Very Well Made
reviews.comment: I was genuinely surprised by how well this was packaged and how much came with it. Assembly was straightforward—follow the YouTube video instructions; they make everything straightforward. Once put together, it feels solid and sturdy, which honestly isn’t always the case with products like this
